title: Laws for Offerings

questions.question: What must a person do if they defraud their neighbor or find lost property and lie about it?
options: Restore it in full and add a fifth of its value
questions.correctAnswer: Restore it in full and add a fifth of its value
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:5 (ESV): "He shall restore it in full and shall add a fifth to it."

questions.question: What was to be kept burning on the altar at all times?
options: The fire on the altar; it shall not go out
questions.correctAnswer: The fire on the altar; it shall not go out
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:13 (ESV): "Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out."

questions.question: Where was the grain offering's remainder to be eaten?
options: In a holy place, in the court of the tent of meeting
questions.correctAnswer: In a holy place, in the court of the tent of meeting
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:16 (ESV): "It shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place. In the court of the tent of meeting they shall eat it."

questions.question: Who could eat the sin offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:26 (ESV): "The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it."

questions.question: What happened to a clay pot used to boil the sin offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:28 (ESV): "The earthenware vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken."

questions.question: What was done with a bronze pot used for the sin offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:28 (ESV): "But if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, that shall be scoured and rinsed in water."

questions.question: What grain offering was the priest to offer on the day of his anointing?
options: A tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering
questions.correctAnswer: A tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:20 (ESV): "This is the offering that Aaron and his sons shall offer to the Lord on the day when he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour."

questions.question: What happened to the priest's grain offering?
options: It was wholly burned; none was eaten
questions.correctAnswer: It was wholly burned; none was eaten
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:23 (ESV): "Every grain offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten."

questions.question: What was the grain offering not to be baked with?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:17 (ESV): "It shall not be baked with leaven."

questions.question: What happened if blood from the sin offering splashed on a garment?
options: The spot must be washed in a holy place
questions.correctAnswer: The spot must be washed in a holy place
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:27 (ESV): "When any of its blood is splashed on a garment, you shall wash the part that was splashed on in a holy place."

questions.question: What was the priest to wear when removing ashes from the altar?
options: His linen garment and linen undergarment
questions.correctAnswer: His linen garment and linen undergarment
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:10 (ESV): "The priest shall put on his linen garment and put his linen undergarment on his body."

questions.question: What did the priest change into before carrying ashes outside the camp?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:11 (ESV): "Then he shall take off his garments and put on other garments and carry the ashes outside the camp."

questions.question: When was the priest's grain offering offered?
options: Half in the morning and half in the evening
questions.correctAnswer: Half in the morning and half in the evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:20 (ESV): "Half of it in the morning and half in the evening."

questions.question: What sins required restitution plus a fifth before a guilt offering could be made?
options: Deceiving a neighbor, robbery, oppression, lying about lost property, or false oaths
questions.correctAnswer: Deceiving a neighbor, robbery, oppression, lying about lost property, or false oaths
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:2-3 (ESV): "If anyone sins and commits a breach of faith against the Lord by deceiving his neighbor... or has found something lost and lied about it."

questions.question: Any sin offering whose blood was brought into the tent of meeting could not be what?
options: Eaten; it must be burned with fire
questions.correctAnswer: Eaten; it must be burned with fire
questions.explanation: Leviticus 6:30 (ESV): "But no sin offering shall be eaten from which any blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place; it shall be burned up with fire."

key_verse_text: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.
